evals.prompt: Make store screenshots and website images for this Flutter app.
evals.expected_output: Runs detect-project.mjs first and checks imageGenToolSynced; if false, tells the user to sync tools/image-gen-tools and does not copy it. Reads the schema from docs/opinions.md instead of restating it, lists the router's routes and asks which screens are ready and in what order, uses token names for colours, and shows the drafted apps/<app>/image-gen.config.json for confirmation before any capture. Copies no tool, Dart template or demo file into the project.

evals.prompt: Regenerate the App Store and Play screenshots, I changed the broker form.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the existing image-gen.config.json, checks a simulator is booted, runs the capture target (flutter drive) for the booted devices, then the store target (nx run image-gen-tools:store -- --app=<app>). Opens one generated image from dist/<app>/store/ and reports any overlap or clipped device. Does not run the website target unless asked.

evals.prompt: Add the Play tablet screenshots too.
evals.expected_output: Adds ipad to capture.devices and android-tablet to store.targets in image-gen.config.json (Play tablet cards use the iPad captures), asks for an iPad simulator to be booted, then runs capture and store through the nx targets. Does not edit tool code.

evals.prompt: Capture the screens for this app (it was created before the capture harness existed).
evals.expected_output: detect-project reports captureSetup without captureTest or driver; the skill tells the user to regenerate the harness with the mobile-app generator and stops before capture. It does not write integration_test files itself.
